name: Pasting up the autumn wall magazine on the corridor board
subject: projects
brief: Your group of three is putting up the Class XI bilingual wall magazine outside Ms Basu's room: lettering the masthead, pasting the essays and poems, and bordering the columns. You are the mediator keeping everyone heard, and there is only one jar of gum-arabic paste and one pair of long scissors between you. Nobody has said when Ms Basu locks the glass frame.

tasks.name: Letter the Bengali and English masthead strip
Rule and paste the four essay and poem columns
Cut and pin the coloured paper border

facts.text: Ms Basu locks the corridor display frame at two o'clock before the staff meeting, not at four
Tara brought her own flat squirrel-hair brush from home

note: Uses Ms Basu (npc_ms_basu), Mira Sen (npc_mira_sen), and Tara Das (npc_tara_das) at Nabapara Vidyalaya (loc_nhss). The deadline constraint is that the display frame is locked at 2:00 p.m., which only Mira knows. The seam: the masthead width and the four essay columns use different margin widths unless the hand-over is inspected.
